architectural_units.name: Security Service
architectural_units.description: Security Service (Traefik) functions as a reverse proxy and load balancer, managing HTTP and HTTPS request routing.

architectural_units.name: System Service
architectural_units.description: System Service (Next.js) serves the web application using React and communicates with the database.

architectural_units.name: Data Service
architectural_units.description: Data Service (PostgreSQL) provides the relational database for storing application data.

architectural_units.name: Traefik
architectural_units.description: Traefik is a modern reverse proxy and load balancer designed to manage incoming and outgoing HTTP and HTTPS traffic.

architectural_units.name: Next.js
architectural_units.description: Next.js is a framework for building web applications that supports both client-side and server-side rendering.

architectural_units.name: PostgreSQL
architectural_units.description: PostgreSQL provides the relational database for storing application data.

architectural_units.name: Prisma
architectural_units.description: Prisma is an ORM tool used to simplify database access and management.

architectural_units.name: Docker
architectural_units.description: Docker is a containerization platform used to manage the execution of the application services.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: Amazon S3 is used for cloud storage to store and retrieve files.

architectural_units.name: Stripe
architectural_units.description: Stripe is integrated to handle payments and subscriptions.

architectural_units.name: Google Analytics
architectural_units.description: Google Analytics is implemented to track and analyze site traffic.

architectural_units.name: Sentry
architectural_units.description: Sentry is used to track and manage errors in the application.

architectural_units.name: Brevo
architectural_units.description: Brevo is used to create, send, and schedule emails.

patterns.name: Observer Pattern
patterns.description: The Observer pattern establishes a one-to-many relationship between objects, where a subject maintains a list of observers.

patterns.name: Singleton Pattern
patterns.description: The Singleton pattern ensures that a class has only one instance and provides a global access point to that instance.
